product_family: BlueWillow is a free AI image generator with freemium model. Free tier: users' prompts and generated assets are available for BlueWillow to license and use. Paid tier: BlueWillow retains no rights to user-created assets. Discord-integrated community platform.

privacy.ai_training_note: Free-tier users grant BlueWillow a 'perpetual, worldwide, non-exclusive, sublicensable, no-charge, royalty-free, irrevocable license' to their prompts and generated assets. Paid users have different terms where BlueWillow retains no rights. This mechanism strongly suggests free user data is used to improve models and train AI.
privacy.data_region: Unspecified. Legal entity LMWR Technology OU is Estonian-registered (LimeWire brand); privacy policy governed by California law, Terms of Service by Delaware law. Data storage location not disclosed in privacy policy.

security.name: Encryption in Transit
security.value: SSL/TLS encryption for certain data transmissions mentioned; explicit disclaimer that BlueWillow cannot guarantee security from unauthorized access.

security.name: Server Monitoring
security.value: Basic server monitoring and monitoring of authorized access; no third-party verification disclosed.

security.name: Data Access Controls
security.value: Authorized personnel only; no role-based access control (RBAC) framework disclosed.

security.name: Security Assurance
security.value: Disclaimer: 'BlueWillow cannot guarantee the security of your Personal Data from unauthorized access, alteration, or disclosure.'

security.name: Third-Party Data Sharing
security.value: Data shared with affiliated parties, related parties for marketing, and unaffiliated third parties 'as necessary.' No explicit list of third parties or data processors disclosed.

security.name: Data Retention
security.value: No specific retention policies disclosed. Company reserves right to transfer data during mergers or asset sales.

products.name: BlueWillow Free Tier
products.data_scope: User prompts, generated images, personal information (email, IP, device info). BlueWillow gains license to use prompts and assets.
products.notes: Free access to AI image generation. Discord-integrated community. Users grant broad license to their data and creations.

products.name: BlueWillow Paid Tier
products.data_scope: User prompts, generated images, personal and billing information. BlueWillow has NO rights to user-created assets.
products.notes: Paid subscription model. User retains full ownership and exclusive rights to created assets. BlueWillow cannot use for training or other purposes.

compare.pricing_model: Freemium - Free tier with community features, paid tier for exclusive asset ownership
